description: Rule configuration values: get reads an owner's param rows, a rule's param-spec, or the catalog of offerable rules; set upserts a row (append-only, effective-dated).

op.description: get: read rows, a spec, or the catalog. set: write a row.

contact_id.description: The worker/entity the params belong to. Omit for general (platform / employer-wide) params. Both ops.

rule.description: get: only this rule's rows (or '_rules' for the worker's rule set) — the answer carries the rule's param-spec too. set (required): the rule name (e.g. us_federal, futa), or '_rules' to set which rules apply to the worker.

param.description: set only, required there: the param JSON for this rule (e.g. the W-4 fields), or {names:[...]} when rule='_rules'.

effective_from.description: set only: YYYY-MM-DD this takes effect; defaults to today. A change is a new dated row, not an overwrite.

catalog.description: get only: list available rules instead of an owner's rows — each {name, spec, callsites}. The menu of offerable instruments.

callsite.description: get only, with catalog=true: only rules attachable at this callsite (e.g. 'pay_run', 'invoice_status'). Omit for every rule, each listing where it can attach. An unknown name returns the list.
